subtitle: Live rates from three sources
blocks: FIXXE is a fast, clean currency converter with live mid-market exchange rates — the neutral midpoint between global buy and sell prices, not bank spreads.

Three rate sources with automatic fallback — ExchangeRate-API, F.A. and Frankfurter (ECB). If a provider is down, the app quietly switches to the next one and shows which source the numbers came from. Most converters depend on a single API and simply show nothing when it fails.

Works offline — the last rates are kept on your device, so the app keeps converting with no connection. And if those rates are more than a day old, it says so plainly instead of pretending they are current.

Smart rounding — your chosen precision is a minimum, not a straitjacket: if rounding would distort the amount by more than 2%, extra decimals are added automatically. 0.94 CHF never becomes "1", and small crypto amounts never collapse to zero.
Dynamic base — rates are recalculated against the currency you are editing, not a fixed one. No switching back and forth.
No ads. No accounts. No tracking. The only permission is internet access; your list, order and settings never leave your device.
Regional currencies that converters often skip: Russian ruble, Serbian dinar, Georgian lari, Tajikistani somoni, Kyrgyz som
Crypto — Bitcoin, Ethereum and 150+ more — and precious metals
Type in any field and every other currency updates instantly
Drag rows by the handle to reorder them, remove one with a single tap
Source-aware search: filter currencies by provider, see where each one is available, switch source in one tap
40 languages, English by default, with an option to follow your device language — right-to-left layouts included
Phone, tablet and web: the same app on iPhone, iPad, Android and as a web app you can install to the home screen
Displayed rates are mid-market reference values, not real-time trading quotes.
ios_desc: iPhone, iPad, and Mac with Apple silicon.
apk_desc: Android without Google Play — Huawei, custom firmware, AOSP.
web_desc: Opens in the browser. Nothing to install.
pwa_desc: The web version becomes an app icon and keeps working offline.
